subject: Azure co-sell: Partner Center field tideline account stitch & seller alignment
messages:
From: AJ Reynolds <aj.reynolds@contoso.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplaceops@microsoft.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell intake — seller mapping ambiguity for Contoso accounts

Hi Kim,

Thanks for taking this. We ran into a bump with Partner Center referrals this week — several Contoso accounts that were auto-ref'd to the field now show up as orphaned in Partner Center and the seller assignment doesn't match our field contacts. This is blocking our next quarterly push.

Attached is our canonical account list (contoso_account_list_v2.csv) and a sample Partner Center referral ID. Can Redwood help stitch the PC referral owner to the right field seller? We also need a lightweight SLA on ownership handoffs for any follow-ups.

Would you and your field team be available for a 30 min sync this week?

Thanks,
AJ Reynolds
Sr. Cloud Alliance Manager
Contoso Corp.

Attachments: contoso_account_list_v2.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: AJ Reynolds <aj.reynolds@contoso.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell intake — seller mapping ambiguity for Contoso accounts

Hi AJ — thanks for the heads up and the list. Looping in Vanessa (go-to-market lead on Azure co-sell) and Karthik (partner integrations) — they'll help map Partner Center referrals back to field owners.

Quick plan:
- Vanessa will run a stitch pass against our field roster and propose a mapping matrix (we'll start with the 120 accounts you attached).
- Karthik will validate which PC referral IDs are eligible for automatic seller attribution vs. those needing manual claim.
- I’ll coordinate a 30-min working session to agree on the final mapping and a short SLA for handoffs.

Proposed times: Tue 11/2 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 11/3 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works for you?

Kimberly Park
Sr. Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--- Original attachment referenced: contoso_account_list_v2.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: AJ Reynolds <aj.reynolds@contoso.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Azure co-sell intake — seller mapping ambiguity for Contoso accounts

Thanks AJ / Kim — I ran an initial stitch against our field seller roster and Partner Center signals. Findings (high level):

- ~78 accounts matched cleanly to an active seller (based on seller email + territory).
- ~22 accounts are contested (duplicate match confidence between two sellers; most are EMEA/US overlap cases).
- ~20 accounts are orphans in PC (no seller assigned in our field roster).

I uploaded a working workbook: rdw-3981-field-tideline-mapping.xlsx (sheet: stitch_v1). I added columns for "recommended_seller", "match_confidence", and "note_source". For contested rows I put a short rationale and suggested next owner.

Proposal for the working session:
1) We'll review the 22 contested accounts live and pick an owner (or agree to escrow).
2) For the orphan bucket, Redwood to take an initial owner assignment where confidence > 0.75; Contoso to confirm.
3) Agree on a 48-hour SLA for ownership confirmations post-mapping and a 7-day escalation path to the PC clearinghouse if either party objects.

I can take Wed 11/3 14:00 PT. Scheduling invite to follow.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Cloud Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: rdw-3981-field-tideline-mapping.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

From: AJ Reynolds <aj.reynolds@contoso.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplaceops@microsoft.com, pc-sync@microsoft.com
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell intake — seller mapping ambiguity for Contoso accounts

Hi Vanessa — Wed 11/3 14:00 PT works for me. Thanks for the clear buckets and suggested rules. Two quick asks ahead of the call:

- Can you populate the workbook with the Contoso account owner email (we'll need that for internal approvals)?
- For any accounts you auto-assign (confidence >0.75), can Redwood create a PC claim request ticket (so Microsoft sees the owner change trace)?

I'll bring Contoso's field GTM lead on the call so we can resolve contested rows quickly.

Regards,
AJ

Attachment: Contoso_field_owner_export.csv (CSV, 16KB)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: AJ Reynolds <aj.reynolds@contoso.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplaceops@microsoft.com
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2027 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell intake — Partner Center field tideline mapping (final)

Thanks everyone — good sync today. Summary and final asks: 

1) Final mapping: Vanessa updated rdw-3981-field-tideline-mapping.xlsx (sheet: final_map). We assigned 102 accounts to field sellers, 18 accounts marked for escrow/handshake, 0 left unknown. Vanessa applied the >0.75 auto-assign rule to the orphan bucket.

2) Action items: 
- Redwood (Vanessa/Karthik) to create Partner Center claim tickets for the 102 auto-assigned accounts by EOD 11/8. (ticket prefix: PC-REQ-RDW3981)
- Contoso (AJ) to confirm ownership on the 18 escrow rows within 48 hours of ticket creation.
- Microsoft Marketplace Ops to acknowledge receipt of the PC claim tickets and confirm next steps for claim processing.

3) SLA & Escalation: 48-hour ownership confirmation; 7-day escalation to PC clearinghouse. Agreed.

4) Attachments: pc-handshake-template.docx (we'll use for contested account outreach) and the final workbook (rdw-3981-field-tideline-mapping.xlsx).

I'll update the HubSpot deal: RDW-3981 and add the final mapping doc link. Thanks again for the speed here — this should unblock next week's co-sell motions.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw-3981-field-tideline-mapping.xlsx (Excel, 52KB), pc-handshake-template.docx (Docx, 28KB)
